# Paragraph 2. Amendment of Third Schedule

2. The Employees Provident Fund Act 1991 is amended by substituting for the Third Schedule the following Schedule:

“THIRD SCHEDULE (Subsection 43(1))

RATE OF MONTHLY CONTRIBUTIONS

The rate of monthly contributions specified in this Part shall apply to—

(a) employees who are Malaysian citizens;

(b) employees who are not Malaysian citizens but are permanent residents of Malaysia; and

(c) employees who are not Malaysian citizens who have elected to contribute before 1 August 1998.

and for the months when the wages exceed RM20,000.00, the rate of contribution by the employee shall be RM9.00, and rate of contribution by the employer shall be RM12.00, for every RM100.00 or part of RM100.00 of the amount of wages for the month.

The rate of monthly contributions specified in this Part shall apply to employees who are not Malaysian citizens—

(a) who elect to contribute on or after 1 August 1998;

(b) who elect to contribute under subsection 54(3) on or after 1 August 1998;

(c) who elect to contribute under paragraph 3 of the First Schedule on or after 1 August 1998; and

(d) who elect to contribute under paragraph 6 of the First Schedule on or after 1 August 2001.
